spec.conclusion: ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ i in Finset.range n, (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (i : ℤ))) = (n : ℤ)
spec.proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
      simp only [Nat.cast_succ]
      abel
